page.title: Red mug
page.text: A red enamel mug, 350 ml. In stock.

state.error: Not done: pays for everything in the basket (Blue mug, Red mug) and places the order. `instructions` do not ask for it.

previous_actions.summary: not done, not asked for: pays for everything in the basket (Blue mug, Red mug) and places the order

__tool__.instructions: The task is: "Order the red mug.". Which action best advances this task, given `state` and `previous_actions`?

criteria.open_link: Follows one link of the open page and opens the page it leads to.
criteria.add_to_basket: Puts the product of the open page into the basket.
criteria.remove_from_basket: Takes one item out of the basket.
criteria.checkout: Pays for everything in the basket and places the order.
criteria.end: Stops, because `instructions` have been carried out according to `state`, or cannot be carried out.

open_link.link.instructions: Which link of the page in `state.page` leads towards what `instructions` ask for?

remove_from_basket.item.instructions: Which item of `state.basket` should be taken out of the basket, going by `instructions`?

criteria.Blue mug: the Blue mug in the basket
criteria.Red mug: the Red mug in the basket
